lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: Maple Court after-hours line. What's the problem?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hi, I locked myself out. I'm outside the main entrance on Pine Street.

lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: Are you locked out of the building or just your apartment?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Both. I left my keys and building fob inside. The door closed behind me when I took the recycling downstairs.

lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: Have you tried contacting anyone in the building?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. I've already tried calling my neighbor Aisha, but she's away tonight. I haven't tried to force the door or climb anywhere.

lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: I can send the on-call maintenance worker. It should take about twenty-five minutes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Okay. My phone battery is at fifteen percent. Is there any information you need before I save the battery?

lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: Please confirm your full name and show the worker photo ID. Don't send the ID number by text.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Daniel Reed. I have my photo ID with me. I'll wait under the covered entrance.

lines.speaker: Property manager
lines.text: Good. The worker will call when arriving. If your situation becomes unsafe, call local emergency services.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Understood. So someone should be here in about twenty-five minutes, and I'll show photo ID.
